lines.cyr: Ах, ти младост, чудна си ми била,
lines.lat: Ah, ti mladost, čudna si mi bila,
lines.en: Ah, you youth, you were strange to me,

lines.cyr: јас се свртев, ти ми избега.
lines.lat: jas se svrtev, ti mi izbega.
lines.en: I turned around, you ran away from me.
How much wine, songs, tears, laughter,

lines.cyr: тебе сум ти дарил за век да те имам.
lines.lat: tebe sum ti daril za vek da te imam.
lines.en: I gave to you so I would have you forever.
two or three tears seem to have fallen.
I look at the alleys, they are the same,
only others have fallen in love.
